statements.t: The Company also announced the successful release of its first commercial-scale cGMP batch of PH-762 drug substance (active pharmaceutical ingredient), representing an important CMC (chemistry, manufacturing and controls) milestone that supports the planned Phase 2b clinical program, which is expected to be initiated in the first quarter of 2027.
Management believes that research and development expenses will continue to increase as we advance our PH-762 program.
